A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OSCAR study, and all 12 supplied pages in each are readable and directly matchable. However, both end with References and omit the appendix cited for derivations, pseudocode, architecture details, and additional comparisons. The judgments below cover the supplied content; that referenced appendix cannot be compared.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-compression evaluations on Kodak, DIV2K-val, and CLIC2020, qualitative reconstructions, and component ablations in Section 4 and Figures 5–8.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark evaluations, reconstructed-image comparisons, and ablation results reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same two-stage OSCAR procedure: representation alignment, bit-rate-specific hyper-encoders, mapping to pseudo diffusion timesteps, and one-step reconstruction through a shared diffusion backbone. The components and losses are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training data from DIV2K, Flickr2K, and LSDIR, totaling 88,441 images, and evaluate the same image-compression task on Kodak, DIV2K-val, and CLIC2020.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the reported comparisons. Figure 5 retains BPG, VVC, DPICT, CTC, HiFiC, MS-ILLM, and PerCo; the comparisons involving CDC and DiffEIC elsewhere in Figures 1, 2, and 6 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same evaluation sample counts, DIV2K-val/CLIC2020 center crops, LPIPS/DISTS/MUSIQ/CLIPIQA metrics, model configurations, and training budgets. Section 4.2 retains the same baseline retraining protocol.

E4.justification: The residual-distribution and QQ analyses in Figure 4 and the ablations in Figures 7–8 are identical. Both versions test representation alignment, calibrated versus random timestep mapping, edge-aware DISTS loss, and GAN loss.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the residual-distribution and QQ plots. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seed information, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: The efficiency comparison, benchmark curves, reconstructed examples, and ablation results are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–12 are pixel-identical, confirming that the plotted results and image panels contain no added, removed, or revised entries.

T1.justification: The displayed equations, Gaussian-noise assumptions, cosine-similarity approximation, and timestep-mapping formulation in Section 3 are identical. The referenced appendix derivation is absent from both supplied PDFs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about one-step diffusion compression, a shared generative model across bit-rates, and favorable reconstruction quality and efficiency.

C2.justification: Both versions give the same interpretation that representation alignment makes residuals approximately Gaussian and preserves structural information sufficient for one-step reconstruction. No applicability qualifications, failure conditions, or limitations are added or revised.

D1.justification: The disclosed Stable Diffusion 2.1 configuration, optimizer settings, LoRA rank, batch sizes, iteration counts, and A6000 hardware are unchanged. Both abstracts retain the same future code-and-model release statement and repository address.

R1.justification: Section 2, the research positioning, and all 57 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page affiliations change Wenbo Li from Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab to The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and Yong Guo from South China University of Technology to Max Planck Institute for Informatics. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes. Scientific prose and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, their captions, panel arrangements, and the body layout are unchanged. The first-page text updates introduce no figure redesign, relocation, or document reflow.

improvement.justification: The supplied v4 changes affiliations and the version/date stamp while preserving the scientific content, evidence, explanations, and reproducibility disclosures. These administrative edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference. The referenced appendix remains absent from both PDFs.
